div.div: سَائِغٌ , applied to beverage, or wine, (JK, K, TA,) and food, (TA,) Descending easily [and agreeably] down the throat; (JK, Msb, K, TA, and Bd and Jel in xvi. 68 and Bd in xxxv. 13;) [or easy and agreeable to swallow;] not choking; (Jel in xvi. 68;) and ↓ أَسْوَغُ signifies the same; (IDrd, K, TA;) and so ↓ سَيِّغٌ , applied to food [&c.]; (TA;) [and ↓ مُسْتَسَاغٌ , accord. to Freytag, as from the K, in which I do not find it.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
